description: The directory hash covers D/.jos/ only (SPEC-2.0 §9.3). A sealed folder whose step runs a program outside D/.jos/ (tool.sh, written after the folder was sealed) runs, and its artifact is the art_ of D/.jos/: it identifies the folder's documents, not the programs they run. A program is pinned with requires[].digest (§6.6), not by the seal.
